name: contextum
description: Context management around a task: /contextum:prepare <topic> gathers the code, tests, history, and recorded decisions a coming task will need into the conversation and reports a short, checkable briefing (read vs. inferred anchors, what was not examined); /contextum:report [task] audits the current context — dead weight with its source (environment / agent / user) and weak spots where the agent relies on assumptions rather than examined material. Fully standalone: two markdown commands; no hooks, no MCP server, no state.
